annotations.title: Who signed this skill / MCP package?

description: Before installing a skill, MCP server or package: give the sha256 of the exact file. Read-only and free. Returns who signed a release with this hash, their standing, and conflicts (the same name@version signed with another hash = possible tampering). Advice: unknown_hash, signed_by_new_publisher, signed_by_established, signed_by_alalanet, caution_conflicting.

sha256.description: sha256 of the artifact, 64 hex characters
